statement_en: If $f \in \mathscr{F}_a$, then for any complex number $\omega \in S_a$, the Fourier transform of the function $x\mapsto f(x-\omega)$ is $$\xi\mapsto e^{-2\pi i \xi \omega }\widehat{f}(\xi).$$
key_techniques: translation property of the Fourier transform
callout_body: 如果$f \in \mathscr{F}_a$那么对于任意的带状区域当中的复数$\omega \in S_a$函数$x\mapsto f(x-\omega)$的傅里叶变换为$$\xi\mapsto e^{-2\pi i \xi \omega }\widehat{f}(\xi)$$
